hilfe.briefing.morgens: In the morning, a briefing arrives with the weather for the day's stage or for the locations of your location comparison (default: 07:00).
hilfe.briefing.abends: In the evening, a briefing arrives with the weather for the next day's stage (trip default: 18:00). The times are set in the Delivery tab of your trip or location comparison.
hilfe.alarme.text: Between briefings, Gregor sends an alert when the weather for your route changes in a relevant way, for example with thunderstorms, heavy rain or storms. The urgency threshold in the Alerts tab defines which level is sent through which channel.
hilfe.kanaele.email: Email: briefing as a table with hourly values, alerts as a separate message.
hilfe.kanaele.telegram: Telegram: briefing and alerts as a message, detailed or in compact style.
hilfe.kanaele.sms: SMS: briefing and alerts as a short text (depending on your plan).
hilfe.kanaele.premium_sms: Premium SMS (Garmin inReach): briefing and alerts as a short text via satellite (depending on your plan).
hilfe.befehle.jetzt.text: Rain and thunderstorms over roughly the next 2 hours
hilfe.befehle.strecke.text: Rain areas along the remaining route
hilfe.befehle.pause.text: Pause briefings for a period of time
hilfe.befehle.startdatum.text: Set the start date of the trip, shift all stages
